cohort: 38 pregnant women with COVID-19 infection admitted to a tertiary care hospital in Himachal Pradesh, India for at least 24 hours.
finding: COVID-19 infection was associated with higher rates of cesarean section in pregnant women.
mod_finding: 60.5% of participants had a vaginal delivery and 39.5% had a cesarean section.
followup_time: Duration of hospital stay (varied, with most patients hospitalized for 3-5 days)
